train_model: train a learned simulator model on particle simulation data using one-step prediction with configurable batch size and noise
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained simulator model on test data and log loss and position MSE metrics
produce_rollouts: produce rollout predictions by running the simulator sequentially over multiple timesteps and save results to pickle files
prepare_inputs: prepare input tensors by transposing positions, extracting targets, and computing particle counts per example
batch_concat: batch a dataset by concatenating samples along the leading axis using windowed reduce operations
